{{Quote|You remember that time we carried those Sacred Way pilgrims to Hoogon Two so they could see the monument built there by their founder? You remember how they looked when they got there and there was no monument?''"<br />"''Haunted.''"<br />"''Right. Haunted. He reminds me of them. He's got that look. Like he learned something he wished he hadn't and it called into question what he believes.|[[Khedryn Faal]] and [[Marr Idi-Shael]]|<ref name="Crosscurrent" />}}
'''Hoogon Two''' was an astronomical object located in the [[Dantus sector/Legends|Dantus sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the site of a supposed monument built by the [[Sacred Way founder|founder]] of the [[Sacred Way/Legends|Sacred Way]], a religious organization.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />

==History==
[[Khedryn Faal]] and [[Marr Idi-Shael]] once brought followers of the [[Sacred Way/Legends|Sacred Way]] to Hoogon Two aboard the [[Junker (YT-2400 light freighter)|''Junker'']], their [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. The followers learned that there was no monument on Hoogon Two and their haunted look of disappointment was remembered by Faal.<ref name="Crosscurrent" />
